question: What is a characteristic of EPLD updates on Cisco MDS 9000 Series switches?
options: EPLD bundles are released separately from a Cisco MDS NX-OS release
EPLD packages update hardware functionality on a device
EPLD updates are nondisruptive to traffic flow
EPLD updates are installed only via the Cisco DCNM GUI
theory: EPLD (Electrically Programmable Logic Device) packages update programmable hardware logic embedded in supervisor, line card, and fabric modules - not the NX-OS software itself - to add hardware-level functionality or fix hardware-related issues; EPLD image versions are tied to (released alongside) specific NX-OS releases, they are disruptive to the module being updated because that module must reload, and they can be installed from the CLI, not only through a GUI tool. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - EPLD Upgrade)
